title: CodeMirror cells must disable indentWithTab or Tab traps keyboard focus
answers: Why can't I tab out of a notebook code/markdown cell?
Keyboard focus gets stuck inside the editor when pressing Tab
Tab key indents instead of moving focus to the next control
How to make a CodeMirror editor keyboard-accessible for leaving the field
body:
Symptom: keyboard users pressing Tab inside a notebook code or markdown cell get indentation instead of moving focus to the language picker, toolbar, or next element — focus is trapped in the editor.
Root cause: CodeMirror's basicSetup binds Tab to indentWithTab by default, so the editor consumes the Tab keypress instead of letting it bubble to normal focus navigation.
Fix pattern: pass indentWithTab={false} to the CodeMirror component so Tab/Shift+Tab move focus normally; rely on other mechanisms (e.g. explicit indent shortcuts) for indenting.
Constraints: applies to any CodeMirror-based editor embedded in a larger keyboard-navigable page (notebook cells, inline editors); do not disable indentWithTab for full-screen/modal code editors where Tab-to-indent is the expected authoring behavior and there's another way to exit.
applies: Any CodeMirror-based editor embedded inside a keyboard-navigable page, e.g. public/app/features/notebook/scene/layout-notebook/cells/*.tsx

search: CodeMirror notebook cells must set indentWithTab={false} to prevent Tab key trapping keyboard focus inside the editor instead of navigating to the next focusable element. The basicSetup binding consumes Tab keypresses by default, blocking focus movement in keyboard-navigable pages. This applies to CodeCell.tsx and MarkdownCellEditor.tsx in public/app/features/notebook/scene/layout-notebook/cells/, and any embedded CodeMirror editor within larger pages; do not apply this constraint to full-screen or modal code editors where Tab-to-indent is the intended authoring behavior.
